seoTitle: Riverside Unified 2028–29 Calendar: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Riverside Unified (RUSD) 2028–29 calendar with the 7th-grade start date, grade-specific final days, holidays, major recesses, official PDF, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Riverside Unified classes begin Monday, August 14, 2028. Seventh graders start earlier, on Friday, August 11. High school and 7th grade students finish May 30, while elementary and 8th grade students finish May 31.
verificationBadgeText: Reviewed August 14, 2026 · Source: Riverside Unified School District
calendarNotes: Seventh grade starts August 11, before general classes begin August 14. Parent/teacher conferences run November 8–9, when elementary students are not in session. Elementary minimum days fall November 3, February 23, and May 18. High school and 7th grade end May 30; elementary and 8th grade end May 31.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Riverside Unified start school in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin on Monday, August 14, 2028. The first day for 7th grade is Friday, August 11, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Are elementary students in school during RUSD parent/teacher conferences?
calendarFaqs.a: No. RUSD lists parent/teacher conferences for November 8–9, 2028, with elementary students not in session.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Riverside Unified Spring Recess in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, March 26 through Friday, March 30, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Riverside Unified in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: High school and 7th grade end May 30, 2029. Elementary and 8th grade end May 31, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every RUSD school follow exactly the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: RUSD publishes a districtwide Calendar at a Glance, but some dates apply only to certain grade levels or school types. Individual schools may also publish campus-specific events, testing dates, bell schedules, and other schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official Riverside Unified 2028–29 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official RUSD Calendar at a Glance PDF linked in the downloads section. MySchoolDates also provides a separate one-time ICS file for the reviewed dates on this page.

definitions.description: Seventh graders begin Friday, August 11, three days before general classes begin Monday, August 14.

definitions.term: Elementary students are out for conferences
definitions.description: Parent/teacher conferences run November 8–9, and elementary students are not in session.
Elementary minimum days fall November 3, February 23, and May 18.

definitions.term: Days off for middle and high school students
definitions.description: Middle school students are not in session October 13 or March 16. Middle and high school students are not in session December 22.

definitions.term: The school year ends on two dates
definitions.description: High school and 7th grade finish May 30; elementary and 8th grade finish May 31.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2027–28?
customSections.content: Compared with 2027–28, RUSD starts and ends later, while Winter Recess is shorter and shifts later.

groups.label: Changes
items: General classes begin August 14, five calendar days later than in 2027–28.
Both grade-level ending dates move five calendar days later: May 30 for high school and 7th grade, and May 31 for elementary and 8th grade.
Winter Recess shifts to December 25–January 5, compared with December 20–January 3 in 2027–28.
